prompt:
Match EXACTLY the art style of the second attached image (the current battle background): a bright cheerful cloud-top bubble world for an all-ages mobile casual game, clean soft outlines, soft controlled cel shading, gentle glossy highlights. Strictly original: no plants, flowers, vegetables, flowerpots, fences, dragons or dinosaurs, nothing resembling any existing game's characters, interface or logos.

ONE complete battle background, portrait 9:16, 1080x1920, opaque, edge to edge. It REPLACES the second attached image: keep its composition, its top clouds, the castle and rainbow in the top-right corner and its lower stage, but make the sky CALMER and slightly DEEPER, push the floating islands far back into haze, and remove all colored decorations from the stage borders. The first attached image shows the target colors and mood (ignore every user-interface element in it). ONLY the background: no user interface, no buttons, no bars, no characters, no bubble grid, no pads, no tubes, no projectiles, no text.

The game draws a dense picture made of small pale mint, peach, orange and black bubbles over the sky from 12% to 59% of the height, across the middle 95% of the width. The sky behind it must be a quiet, even, clean blue so that these pale bubbles stand out clearly against it.

Layout from top to bottom (percent of image height):
- 0% to 9%: sky with a few small fluffy white clouds in the top-left; a tiny distant fairy-tale castle and a short rainbow arc on clouds in the top-right corner, as in the second image. The middle of the top stays calm.
- 9% to 56%: a CALM, PLAIN, CLEAN clear-day blue sky: one smooth vertical gradient, deeper than the current one but NOT gray and NOT dark (about #3578DA at 10%, #498AE2 at 30%, #5C9BEA at 50%, #62A0EC at 56%). No clouds, no islands, no birds, no sparkles, no highlights and no texture anywhere in this band, edge to edge.
- 50% to 56%: only the faintest hint of distant floating islands and cloud tops, almost dissolved into the blue haze, very low contrast, no bright whites, no waterfalls in front.
- 56% to 60%: a thin soft bank of white cloud tops, the only bright white in the lower half of the sky, handing over to the stage (the game draws a thin glowing foam rail at 58.5%).
- 60% to 100%: the lower stage exactly like the second image: a soft light frosted blue-gray tray (about #AAC1DD at its top fading to about #9DB4D2 at the bottom) that blends into puffy white clouds on the left, right and bottom; no hard rectangular frame. The side and bottom borders are PLAIN WHITE AND PALE-BLUE CLOUDS ONLY: no balloons, no eggs, no colored bubbles, no stars, no rainbow arcs. The center of the tray (middle 80% of the width, from 62% to 97% of the height) stays plain and evenly lit, because pads, creatures, numbers and three buttons are drawn on top.
The whole image is ONE painting with consistent soft daylight, not pasted layers. Clouds stay pure white with soft pale-blue shading, never gray.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.

FINAL TARGETED EDIT: The first three references have the roles above. The FOURTH attachment is the latest draft; refine it. Keep all existing correct objects and remove no upper castle or rainbow.

Mandatory geometric correction: in the fourth image the lower white cloud bank starts too early, at54% height. Compress that entire cloud bank VERTICALLY so its TOP is at56.3% and its BOTTOM remains at59.8%. Keep the upper stage boundary at59.8% exactly. Thus there is no bright cloud pixel anywhere in the 9%-56% sky band, including left and right edges. Make only a narrow, soft scalloped white cloud bank, not huge tall side-cloud mounds. The faint blue island silhouettes above it should become 80 percent more faint and shrink back into the extreme side horizon at51%-55.5%, almost fully lost in haze. No waterfalls. No central island silhouettes or cloud texture.

Mandatory color correction: sky must match the target solid blue gradient swatches. In the fourth draft, center10% is #347EEC,30% #4B96F8,50% #5BA5FD, all too bright blue. Correct them to #3578DA, #498AE2, #5C9BEA respectively, with smooth transitions. This means reduce the green channel slightly and the blue channel clearly, while retaining similar red, so it is calm clear-day BLUE, not dim gray. It must visibly become a bit deeper and less electric. Do not make it pale powder blue.

The lower tray should visibly become less blue and more neutral frosted blue-gray like attachment2: change its center62% from #ABC5E7 to #B5C8DE; center80% from #97B8E3 to #A6BCDA; center97% from #88ADDD to #9BB6D5. Increase the muted warm gray component slightly and reduce excessive blue. Keep the cloud whites white; only change the tray surface. Keep the empty stage and plain cloud-only borders. Bottom cloud tops confined to97%-100%, side clouds in outer8% only. No text or GUI.
